review.demo_recommendation: Proceed with 3D demo rendering using the provided STEP files. Prioritize visual validation of the top 5 hero components (MCU, Joystick, Keypresses, Encoder, RGB LEDs) as they define the demo's interactive and aesthetic narrative. Do not attempt to infer or correct dimensions for any component; rely solely on the provided verified mechanical dimensions.

systemic_findings: All 29 components report 'mechanical_dimensions_verified' fidelity; no envelope-only or supplier-verified discrepancies detected in metadata.
No geometry or release authority is available to validate the internal accuracy of the STEP files beyond hash matching.
Tiny passives (0603 resistors/capacitors) are excluded from hero ranking due to minimal visual impact on 3D demo despite high occurrence counts.
All STEP file hashes are present and distinct, indicating unique CAD assets per component instance.
